works.title: Oracle
works.description: A distributed adversarial-intelligence system designed to surface moral truth and expose institutional corruption through sophisticated language analysis and embodied moral-meaning detection. Oracle recouples visceral with intellectual reasoning to collapse empire's epistemological separations, featuring identity-resistant networks, cryptographic verification protocols, and a multi-phase anonymous release strategy resistant to adversarial poisoning attacks.
works.quote: Oracle functions as the modern path out of epistemic Samsara: a visible, accessible way to stop exhausting oneself in denial and simply perceive truth.

works.title: Natural Language Programming for AI Agents (Book 1)
works.description: A narrative-driven technical book on programming methodologies with AI agents, using Malcolm Gladwell's narrative intelligence and Richard Feynman's delighted directness. The book addresses five failure modes as a unified problem, providing systematic architecture for building frameworks and processes that work across any model. Author has completed through chapter 4 with full outline and stylistic voice guide.
works.quote: I think we're done through chapter 4, but I'll probably revisit it one more time because it was a pretty extensive rewrite and I'll want to go through it again.
